batch: P6 / T21 – image/text input, Chinese IME and draft lifecycle

environment.type: jsdom frontend integration harness with real Vue Router and full App; real Edge browser for IME, clipboard, drag/drop and BroadcastChannel
environment.test_runner: vitest 5.0.5; playwright-core 1.64.1 driving system Microsoft Edge
environment.network: stubbed / mocked HTTP; no provider or image service call
environment.data_root: in-memory frontend harness; no local business database

scope: one composer remains at the bottom of the chat; Enter and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter send, Shift+Enter creates a newline, and IME composition Enter never sends
blank and identical in-flight content cannot submit twice
one reference image can be prepared by picker, paste or drop with preview, replace and remove; ordinary text paste is not swallowed and dropping a non-image does not navigate
reference upload/replace is bound to the account, project and revision that started it; a late response after project/session change cannot attach to the later workspace
same-project chat/results navigation keeps the draft and pending attachment preparation; switching project or leaving with either kind of unsaved content warns and clears only after confirmed discard
refresh does not persist unsent drafts or temporary images; logout/account switch/cross-tab invalidation clears drafts, project state and temporary images
attachment, navigation and keyboard input cannot impersonate generation authorization; paste/drop never submits a message or generation
inputs: real App and Vue Router mounted in jsdom with the existing FetchController HTTP seam
delayed reference upload, project list with an unloaded project B, project B detail, reference upload and message response stubs
real Edge at 1440×1000 with clipboard permissions, CDP Input.imeSetComposition, real BroadcastChannel cross-tab invalidation, and mocked /api responses
1×1 PNG clipboard file and plain-text file drop
commands: node D:/.dsh/tmp/spec86/21-browser-check.mjs (real Edge + playwright-core; HTTP mocked)

commands_output.result: ok=true; compositionstart + keydown isComposing observed, Enter did not send; real clipboard text paste inserted; real clipboard PNG produced one pending preview; text drop did not navigate or upload; attachment-only switch warning shown; cancel preserved pending; cross-tab BroadcastChannel with changed session id cleared draft and pending; double Enter produced one message POST

calls.note: T21 frontend tests and the real-browser check use HTTP doubles only. The browser check observed exactly one POST /api/projects/{A}/reference, zero POST /api/projects/{B}/reference, one POST /api/projects/{A}/messages from the duplicate-Enter probe, and zero generation submissions.

acceptance.FE3-AC-11: pass — one bottom composer, Enter/Ctrl/Cmd send, Shift+Enter newline, Chinese IME composition Enter does not send, blank/in-flight dedupe, picker/paste/drop preview, replace/remove, normal text paste and non-navigation drop are covered by jsdom and real Edge.
acceptance.FE3-AC-12: pass — same-project chat/results keeps draft and pending attachment; project switch warns for attachment-only changes; confirmed discard clears; account/lifecycle and real cross-tab BroadcastChannel invalidation clear drafts and temporary images; no local business database or cross-device sync is introduced.

ticket_items.1_single_composer_and_keyboard: pass — existing t03 covers Enter/Shift+Enter/IME/Ctrl+Enter; T21 adds duplicate-Enter in-flight test and real Edge composition Enter probe.
ticket_items.2_one_reference_image: pass — existing t05 covers picker/drop/preview/replace/remove; T21 adds composer paste and real clipboard PNG; exactly one upload request.
ticket_items.3_text_paste_and_drop: pass — T21 jsdom asserts normal paste is not prevented and non-image drop changes neither URL nor writes; real Edge confirms clipboard text insertion and text drop no navigation.
ticket_items.4_upload_binding_and_late_isolation: pass — T21 delayed reference upload after switching to project B; only project A had one upload request, B had zero, and no pending attachment appeared under B; existing t05 covers revision binding and unknown receipt verification.
ticket_items.5_same_project_routes: pass — T21 pushes project-results and back to project-chat; draft value and pending preview remain; ResultsPage has no composer.
ticket_items.6_switch_and_leave_warning: pass — attachment-only switch opens UnsavedChangesDialog listing 尚未上传完成的参考图; cancel preserves pending, confirm clears it.
ticket_items.7_refresh_and_lifecycle: pass — no persistence added; sessionRevision test and real cross-tab BroadcastChannel invalidation clear draft and pending image; beforeunload protection includes attachmentPending.
ticket_items.8_no_local_business_db: pass — only reactive page state and sessionStorage helpers already used by the shell; no IndexedDB/localStorage business database or cross-device sync.
ticket_items.9_no_authorization_impersonation: pass — paste/drop and navigation issue no message or generation POST; substantive text still goes through send or the request_new_version workflow action, which remains the only generation authorization path.
ticket_items.10_real_browser_FE3_AC_11_12: pass — real Edge browser check result ok=true; API endpoints are mocked, so provider/model calls remain zero.

probes.results: T21 6 passed; full frontend 214 passed; typecheck clean; browser ok=true

residual_unknowns: The real-browser check uses mocked HTTP responses rather than the live backend/provider; it proves browser event and lifecycle behavior, not network or model behavior.
Clipboard image paste is exercised through the browser clipboard API; some browsers or permission policies may not support image clipboard writes.
Drag/drop is a real browser DataTransfer event, not an OS file drag from Explorer.
Firefox and Safari were not run; Edge Chromium is the only real browser in this evidence.
No backend suite was rerun because T21 changes only frontend state and presentation.
acceptance_notes: Completion is based on the focused T21 suite, full frontend suite, typecheck and a real Edge browser check. Source commit e5fb03e; evidence committed separately.
